children: Osisko Critical Minerals Corporation (OCMC), a newly created, wholly-owned subsidiary of Osisko Metals Incorporated (OMNZF), has announced a
of special warrants to raise gross proceeds of $100M.
Led by Canaccord Genuity Corp. as sole bookrunner and lead agent, the offering will issue special warrants at $0.25 each.

Upon satisfying customary release conditions, including obtaining TSX Venture Exchange conditional listing approval and filing a final prospectus within 180 days of closing, each special warrant will automatically convert into a unit comprising one common share and one-half warrant.
Each full warrant will allow holders to buy an additional common share at $0.35 for 24 months.

The transaction also includes assigning options on 2,972 mineral claim units covering roughly 645 square kilometers staked by the Osisko Metals and claims which it has an option to acquire pursuant to three separate option agreements.
Expected to close on or about November 17, 2026, the net funds will directly finance exploration, property development, and general corporate working capital.
